title: The route to Marrowgate from any of the eastern/southern holds (Fenmarch, the Shieldings, the Fallows, Hollowbrook, the Meres) is not signposted from that side at all — Wardmoor and Coldpass are only reachable by backtracking all the way to the Vale's barrow field and going north from there. Nothing in the Meres' 'get your bearings,' Hollowbrook's landmarks, or any NPC dialogue in that whole eastern cluster hints that the only road to Coldpass runs back through the Vale rather than onward from where a thorough player naturally ends up. This consumed nearly the entire 650-turn budget before the true route was found, leaving no turns left to act on the Hollow Throne itself once the capital was finally reached.
